readme:
# Pathfinder source-bound bench candidate

This is a separate candidate derived from the preserved Pathfinder project `c9ede30a619b12d7c97056a2da040cc1`. The original PCB and CAD revisions remain preserved.

## Saved assets

- Native carrier: `pcb_af828a3152e61e08@0`, PCB `sha256:0a2355f26284a52bd9dfdae7e4aa2eb68744fecfe07d463cdb6c3cca607e3c93`.
- Exact native rules: `sha256:c7b4df33e64a13bc636c3d9718076504a1146dde8c49e8c13f4bb6b3ebb0c850`.
- CAD: [PuRrQzv1 revision 2](https://app.kernelcad.com/p/PuRrQzv1?version=2&show_electronics=1).
- CAD source SHA-256: `2d632a78aadd0d2900c4d8bd2aa0fe8834411039cfb3d4f038c222e972b5a3d9`.
- The diagram carries all 37 source-to-native footprint/pad bindings in `pcbAssembly`. A binding declaration requires validation; it is not itself a circuit-parity pass.

## Design and evidence

The carrier is 31.5 × 235 × 1.6 mm. It fits a 242 mm carrier frame inside a 250 mm coupler with a nominal 38 mm bore. The conservative cassette radius is18.4 mm, giving0.6 mm nominal radial clearance. The minimum component-envelope radial clearance is1.120525 mm. Static CAD and the bounded axial insertion path pass under the documented removal and disconnection steps; fabrication tolerances, retention, wire bends and strain relief remain physical gates.

All 38 original functional parts remain, with three explicit harness interfaces, giving41 device parts and37 carrier parts. The battery, boost converter, panel switch and1.5-ohm load are off the carrier. The1.5-ohm part is external bench equipment: the unchanged1000 ms pulse dissipates an ideal12.615 W /12.615 J at4.35 V before real losses.

The current native PCB passed independent hosted KiCad10.0.8 DRC with zero errors and zero open connections. It has580 tracks and65 vias. The sourced identity edit preserved every footprint/pad/net/track/via coordinate and board outline. The native board's generic importer still has explicit identity/model gaps; DRC does not establish logical or runtime parity.

Power tracks use1.8 mm for VBAT/common ground,1.0 mm for the switched bench return,0.6 mm for5 V, and0.5 mm for3.3 V. The nominal2 oz copper and via-plating assumptions, actual path lengths and resistance estimates are recorded in the examples. Current, voltage sag, camera peaks, connector/cable losses and thermal performance remain unmeasured.

## Firmware and acceptance scope

Firmware and all input vectors are retained from the original project. Requirement assertions are unchanged; their text identifies them as replay checks. The old364 m trajectory and old mass/stability claims do not apply to this revised assembly. Complete physical mass, CG and flight stability remain unknown until the measured inputs and asymmetric camera-pod effects are resolved.

The examples receipt separately records source provenance, nominal fit, routing/DRC, native-model coverage, source-diagram replay, mass assumptions and physical holds. No manufacturing, current/thermal or flight qualification is claimed.
